source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Ghost (archived 20 June 2018)

powerGrid.note: Marvel's page is the Iron Man foe (first seen Iron Man #219), but every readable archived copy (2013 to 2018) shows only the blank default grid, all bars at minimum. Older copies used a Flash grid. Not estimated.

powerOrigins.detail: A former data engineer who infused his body with his own GhostTech phasing technology; his suit and mask control the intangibility and invisibility.

abilities.name: Intangibility
abilities.detail: Harnesses polarised eternons to make himself, and whatever he touches, pass through solid matter; he turns partly see-through while phased.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.detail: Turns himself and what he touches invisible to eyes and most sensors; smoke or mist can still reveal his outline.

abilities.name: Electronics override
abilities.detail: His suit can disrupt machines by touch, and once took control of MACH-V's armour by phasing into it.

abilities.name: Master hacker
abilities.detail: A former data engineer who brushes past firewalls and breaks into most computer systems with ease.

abilities.name: Inventor
abilities.detail: Designed nearly all of his own arsenal, and later upgraded his suit to mask sounds, even his heartbeat.

abilities.name: Weapons and explosives
abilities.detail: Carries high-powered firearms and explosives, and his suit can deliver electric shocks strong enough to drop a man.

abilities.name: Scanners and levitation
abilities.detail: His mask detects heartbeats and can read lips from afar; the suit lets him float and fly slowly.

feats.text: Used modified intangibility circuits to leave the assassin Spymaster half-phased into a wall, killing him.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Iron Man Vol 1 220

feats.text: Working for A.I.M., nearly defeated Iron Man in one clash and escaped unharmed.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Iron Man Vol 3 44

feats.text: Phased into teammate MACH-V's armour and took over control of the suit from the inside.
Kicked a full-size Ant-Man through several walls, then phased through Hank Pym's van to kick the Wasp into the street.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Ant-Man and the Wasp

feats.text: Forced Hank Pym to hand over his lab by threatening to solidify her phased hand inside his neck.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Ant-Man and the Wasp

feats.text: Held her own against Yelena Belova, John Walker and Taskmaster in the O.X.E. vault brawl.
